risk_note: RV1 (identity; no migration, no contract change). D10-1034 ②: device registration checked a device.invalid_hashes set loaded once at startup from the specs seeds (TODO waiting for config reading); B1-02zzh registered device.invalid_hashes (config.risk, object, seeded with specs/device-hash.vectors.json invalid_hash_seeds). invalid-device-hashes.ts invalidDeviceHashesOf / createInvalidDeviceHashes: the set is the seeds ∪ the configured items that are 64-char lowercase hex strings (other items ignored one by one); no row, a wholly invalid value or a read failure leave only the seeds — the seeds always apply and cannot be removed (never looser). register-device.service.ts: a malformed hash is still 20001 without reading config; otherwise the list is read per app before any transaction (no pool connection borrowed while one is held), uncached per call so the next registration sees a changed row (rule tests #3 / #7) — one primary-key read per device registration, acceptable for that endpoint. identity.module.ts reads through LANDING_CONFIG's pool-bound reader (the dedicated per-call reader would be wired in app.module.ts, outside the paths). The warn carries only {app_id, key}. 20001 data.fields=[device_hash] unchanged. Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21).
